name: Kabir Mehta
bio: Photographer working in product, food, fashion and portrait photography.
artist_vibe_summary: Kabir Mehta’s portfolio demonstrates a polished commercial aesthetic characterized by sharp subject focus, controlled studio lighting, and deliberate color palettes tailored for high-end fashion and beauty products. His technical strengths lie in executing clean product branding with dramatic accents—such as water splashes and complementary fruit styling—alongside moody, high-contrast portraiture and streetwear editorials. Overall, he delivers consistent commercial production value with professional staging and well-composed, versatile imagery suited for modern marketing campaigns.
